summary.notes: Continuation of the incomplete 2026-11-01 attempt. Combined coverage: 430/430 active ranked employers have explicit outcomes; 977/977 mapped employer-city pairs were checked; all 14 registered Job Search cities received broad discovery; 108 existing role-city rows were included in the refresh set. The remaining 142 employers without mapped target-city offices were individually audited in this continuation (Asia 48, Americas 47, EMEA/Oceania 47). Thirty-nine new discrete vacancy-city rows were added after registry and Jobs deduplication; two evergreen trading application routes were kept in Application Routes and excluded from Jobs. One confirmed closed RWE posting was archived. Source limitations and uncertain leads are not counted as confirmed open matches and remain itemized in regional triage files. Application/interview Status values were preserved except that the closed role was moved to the archive sheet.

Remaining evidence limitations include Kansai Electric's dynamic, inaccessible role-level inventory; several employer ATS pages that render without role detail; some company-wide boards without requisition-specific detail; and ambiguous/likely closed listings. See triage-americas.md, triage-asia.md, and triage-emea.md; recheck unresolved leads next sweep rather than treating them as no-match.

summary.results_summary: 39 new role-city vacancy rows added; two evergreen routes remain separate in Application Routes; one confirmed closed role moved to Expired Roles; 146 active in-scope role-city rows remain in Jobs, plus five out-of-scope historical rows. The 2026-11-01 first attempt remains recorded as incomplete; this resumed run closes its 142-employer gap. Three deadlines within 7/30 days remain flagged from the original run.
